data.one_liner: Useful builders for your GraphQL SDL and documents.
data.what_it_does: Generates Dart code from GraphQL source, including AST representations, typed data views, variable classes, schema data classes, and built_value serializers.
use_when: You want type-safe GraphQL requests and responses in Dart or Flutter
You use build_runner and want to automatically generate GraphQL models and serializers
avoid_when: You do not use code generation or build_runner in your project
Your project does not use GraphQL
strengths: Provides multiple specialized builders like ast_builder, data_builder, var_builder, schema_builder, and serializer_builder
Supports tristate optionals to distinguish between absent, null, and non-null values
Customizable scalar type overrides and enum fallbacks
weaknesses: Requires setting up build_runner and code generation steps
Relies on external code generation dependencies and built_value infrastructure
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package and build_runner to dev_dependencies and configuring a build.yaml file for code generation.
